1988 TV Serial Dil Dariya (dil dariya) - Episode 6
The serial Dil Dariya (1988) directed by Lekh Tandon, primarily revolved around Punjab and its culture. The main plot may be jotted down as a tension between two families which still prevails even now.
The story was based on two best friends (and neighbours too) hailing from two different religious community, Hindu and Sikh respectively turns into a stringent and tensed relationship due to the tensed atmospheric situations prevailing in Punjab.
